name: REM sleep
rangeNote: There's no target to reach. REM sleep is roughly 20–25 % of sleep in adults, mostly in the second half of the night. Wearables estimate it and often misjudge it; compare nights on the same device.
summary: Time in rapid eye movement (REM) sleep, the stage with most dreaming. As measured by a wearable, it's an estimate.

high.meaning: More REM than usual often follows a night with too little of it.
commonCauses: Rebound after short nights or alcohol

low.meaning: Less REM than usual often follows alcohol, a short night (REM is mostly late in the night) or some medicines.

sources.title: Meta-analysis of quantitative sleep parameters from childhood to old age in healthy individuals: developing normative sleep values across the human lifespan
Wearable Sleep Technology in Clinical and Research Settings
